title: 第15章 年轻人还是心性不定第16章 风语者
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
晨曦历9266年，夏木阴阴。
训练场，魔法区。
阳光透过叶窗的缝隙，在木质地板上投下斑驳的光影。
安静的树屋里，回荡着达里安沉稳平和的声音。
“......闪电箭的关键在于‘极性锁定’，雷电天生趋向扩散，必须用精神力强制赋予它方向性，就像给水开凿一条河道，让它只能朝一个方向奔涌。”
“其符文模型核心是一个楔形结构，尖端指向目标，注入魔力时，楔尖最先完成充能，雷元素便会沿着楔尖所指的方向喷射而出......”
讲台下方，六名年轻精灵凝神倾听，时不时低头做笔记。
继安东之后，埃蒙和布莱登也相继构筑出了魔力回路，开始学习魔法。
之后又有三个新人陆续加入，组成了如今的小课堂。
上午课程结束后，达里安照例单独留下安东，给他讲解了几个疑难后，才温声询问：“你已经很久没找我申领卷轴材料了，是不是放弃学习抄录卷轴了？”
安东微微一怔，随即装作有些不好意思地点点头：“我觉得我在这方面没什么天赋，还是不浪费时间了。”
事实上他根本没花多少时间在学习抄录卷轴上。
之所以这些年没再薅达里安的材料，完全是因为有了稳定的材料来源。
再者，二十多年的练习下来，他绘制符箓的技艺精进不少。
如今绘制聚灵符、纳物符和匿息符这些练习次数最多的符箓时，基本不需要灵引辅助，对材料的需求大幅降低。
或许再过几年，即便不借助任何灵引，他也能绘制全部符箓了。
听了安东的话，达里安微微颔首：“也好，这样你可以把更多心思放在学习魔法上......”
见导师又要老生常谈，安东连忙岔开话题：“老师，魔法除了抄录卷轴，还有哪些技艺？”
达里安被打断也不恼，耐心讲解道：“魔法一共有三大技艺，分别是附魔、炼金和药剂制作。”
“其中附魔学代表的是符文与能量的沟通，各种自启动法阵、持久性装置，这些都离不开附魔师精心刻印的符文效果，严格说起来，卷轴抄录也属于附魔学的分支之一。”

“炼金学代表的则是物质与结构的转化，更注重将魔力固化于特定媒介中，创造出持久而稳定的超凡效果，像是魔法物品制造和傀儡炼制，就都属于炼金学的范畴。”
“至于药剂制作，就不用我多说了吧。”
达里安看向安东，“你问这个，是想学习其他技艺？”
“稍微有点兴趣。”
安东本来只是想转移话题，可达里安这一通讲解，反倒勾起了他的兴致。
药剂制作和附魔学就算了。
等他突破到炼气中期，就能开始修习炼丹之道。
而就他目前了解到的晨曦大陆的药剂效果，真是连给丹道提鞋都不配。
说到底，晨曦大陆的药剂发展还是太粗糙了。
不仅药剂种类丰富度远不如丹道，上限也不高。对于黄金位阶以上的强者，基本起不到什么效果。
可丹道不同，哪怕是渡劫期甚至是大乘期大能，依旧有能够生效的顶级丹药。
甚至还有传说中仙人服用的仙丹。
不管从哪方面看，修仙体系里的丹道都碾压晨曦大陆的药剂太多。
content_en:
The dawn is in the calendar year 9266, and the summer trees are dark.
Training ground, magic zone.
The sun shines through the gaps in the shutters, casting mottled light and shadow on the wooden floor.
Darien's calm and peaceful voice echoed in the quiet treehouse.
"...The key to lightning arrows is 'polarity locking'. Lightning naturally tends to spread, and mental power must be used to force it to have directionality, just like digging a river for water so that it can only flow in one direction."
"The core of its rune model is a wedge-shaped structure, with the tip pointed at the target. When magic is injected, the tip of the wedge is the first to complete charging, and the thunder element will be ejected in the direction pointed by the tip of the wedge..."
Below the podium, six young elves listened attentively, lowering their heads to take notes from time to time.
Following Anton, Eamonn and Brendan also built magic circuits one after another and began to learn magic.
After that, three new people joined one after another, forming the current small classroom.
After the morning class, Darien left Anton alone as usual. After explaining a few problems to him, he asked warmly: "You haven't asked me to apply for scroll materials for a long time. Have you given up on learning to copy scrolls?"
Anton was slightly startled, then pretended to be a little embarrassed and nodded: "I don't think I have any talent in this area, so I won't waste my time."
In fact he spent little time learning to copy the scrolls.
The reason why we haven’t collected materials from Darien in recent years is entirely because we have a stable source of materials.
Furthermore, after more than twenty years of practice, his skills in drawing talismans have improved a lot.
Nowadays, when drawing the most commonly practiced talismans, such as the spirit-gathering talisman, the object-holding talisman and the information-concealing talisman, there is basically no need for spiritual guidance assistance, and the demand for materials has been greatly reduced.
Maybe in a few years, he will be able to draw all the talismans without using any spiritual guidance.
After listening to Anton's words, Darien nodded slightly: "That's fine, so you can focus more on learning magic..."
Seeing that his mentor wanted to talk to him again, Anton quickly changed the subject: "Teacher, besides copying scrolls, what other skills are there in magic?"
Darien was not annoyed when he was interrupted, and patiently explained: "There are three major skills in magic, namely enchantment, alchemy and potion making."
"Among them, enchantment represents the communication between runes and energy, various self-activating magic circles, and persistent devices. These are all inseparable from the effects of the runes carefully engraved by the enchanter. Strictly speaking, scroll transcription is also one of the branches of enchantment."
"Alchemy represents the transformation of matter and structure, and focuses more on solidifying magic power in a specific medium to create long-lasting and stable extraordinary effects. Such as the creation of magic items and the refining of puppets, they all fall under the category of alchemy."
"As for potion making, I don't need to say more."
Darien looked at Anton, "You ask this because you want to learn other skills?"
"A little bit interested."
Anton originally just wanted to change the topic, but Dallian's explanation actually aroused his interest.
Forget about potion making and enchantment.
When he breaks through to the middle stage of Qi refining, he can start practicing the method of alchemy.
And based on what he has learned so far about the effects of the medicine in Dawn Continent, it is really not even worthy of carrying Dan Dao's shoes.
After all, the pharmaceutical development in Dawn Continent is still too rough.
Not only is the variety of medicines far less rich than Alchemy, but the upper limit is also not high. It has basically no effect on the powerful people above the gold rank.
But the way of elixir is different. Even if you are in the Tribulation Stage or even the Mahayana Stage, there are still top-level elixirs that can be effective.
There are even elixirs that are said to be taken by immortals.
No matter which way you look at it, there are too many medicines in the alchemy system that can overwhelm Chenxi Continent.
